digest.component_or_area: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ linting checks configuration
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families are not yet selected in the global linting configuration; six diagnostics currently exist across src/rebar and tests that must be resolved before selection.

Validation timestamps lack explicit timezone semantics: epoch seconds use datetime.fromtimestamp() without tz argument, and persisted timestamp strings are parsed without tzinfo and must be assigned UTC.

Security-pin cadence decision logic must obtain an aware current instant with explicit timezone, convert to host local time, and extract the local date to preserve calendar-date semantics while satisfying DTZ005.
Test suite must prove timezone invariance by executing validation behavior under at least two distinct TZ environment values on platforms supporting time.tzset().
Production code must use datetime.timezone.utc exclusively for UTC construction; the literal datetime.UTC token is prohibited due to py310 target-version constraint.
